**Note on review scope:** Only the diffstat was provided, not the actual code diff, so I can't verify the specific logic changes (e.g., correctness of the rotation algorithm, timing, or edge cases around key expiry). - Thread-safety/atomicity of the rotation if session state is shared
- Test coverage for the refactored logic (no test files appear in this diff)
